method_card.title: Relationships and Future Plans
method_card.content:
This lesson covers relationships and marriage vocabulary, and the conditional/Konjunktiv II for expressing future wishes, ideal partner descriptions and plans.

GermanEnglish
die Hochzeitthe wedding
die Ehemarriage
heiratento get married
zusammenwohnento live together
ich möchteI would like
ich würdeI would
ich werdeI will (future)
hättewould have (conditional)
wärewould be (conditional)
ledig bleibento stay single
Kinder habento have children
einerseits / andererseitson one hand / on the other hand
in der Zukunftin the future
in zehn Jahrenin ten years
unabhängigindependent

Grammar focus — conditional (Konjunktiv II): German uses Konjunktiv II for wishes, hypothetical descriptions and plans. The most common forms are:

  • Ich möchte + infinitive at end: Ich möchte in zehn Jahren heiraten. (I would like to get married in ten years.)
  • Ich würde + infinitive at end: Ich würde gern ein Haus kaufen. (I would like to buy a house.)
  • wäre (would be) — standalone: Mein idealer Partner wäre geduldig.
  • hätte (would have) — standalone: Er hätte braune Haare.

Key rule: after möchte and würde, the infinitive goes to the end of the sentence. The future tense werden + infinitive follows the same rule: Ich werde in der Zukunft heiraten.

Model paragraph: Ich möchte in zehn Jahren heiraten und eine Familie gründen. Mein idealer Partner wäre ehrlich und geduldig. Er hätte braune Haare und würde mir immer zuhören. Einerseits ist die Ehe romantisch, andererseits kostet es zu viel Geld. (I would like to get married in ten years and start a family. My ideal partner would be honest and patient. He would have brown hair and would always listen to me. On one hand marriage is romantic, on the other hand it costs too much money.)
steps: Learn marriage and relationship vocabulary including heiraten, zusammenwohnen, ledig bleiben
Master the conditional: möchte/würde + infinitive at the END of the sentence
Use wäre (would be) and hätte (would have) for ideal partner descriptions — no infinitive needed
Use werden + infinitive for the simple future tense
Present balanced arguments with einerseits (on one hand) and andererseits (on the other hand)

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — future plans and conditional are essential for higher marks

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Ich möchte in zehn Jahren heiraten.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Ich möchte = I would like. This is the conditional verb in position 2.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: in zehn Jahren = in ten years. This is the time phrase.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: heiraten = to get married. This is the infinitive at the end of the sentence.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I would like to get married in ten years.

worked_examples.question: Explain the word order rule with 'möchte' and 'würde'.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Möchte and würde are conditional verbs. They go in position 2 (conjugated verb slot).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: The main verb (infinitive) goes to the end of the sentence.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Pattern: Subject + möchte/würde + extra information + infinitive. Example: Ich möchte ein Haus kaufen. (I would like to buy a house.)

bronze.question: Match the German relationship words to the English meaning
Match the conditional verbs to the English meaning
Complete the conditional sentence — infinitive goes to the END
sentence_parts: Ich möchte in der Zukunft ein Haus

gaps.correct_explain: With möchte, the infinitive goes to the end: Ich möchte ein Haus kaufen.

wrong.kaufe: kaufe is the present tense ich form. After möchte, use the infinitive: kaufen.
wrong.gekauft: gekauft is the past participle. After möchte, use the infinitive: kaufen.

gaps.correct_explain: wäre (would be) is the Konjunktiv II form of sein. It does not need an infinitive at the end.

wrong.ist: ist is present tense. For hypothetical/ideal descriptions, use the conditional: wäre.

bronze.question: What does 'Man kann ohne Ehe glücklich sein' mean?
options: You can be happy without marriage
You cannot be happy without marriage

bronze.question: What does 'Einerseits ist die Ehe romantisch' mean?
options: On one hand, marriage is romantic
On the other hand, marriage is romantic

model_answers: I would not like to have children.
I wouldn't like to have children.

silver.question: Complete the sentence (no word bank)
silver.english: My ideal partner **would have** brown hair and **would be** very patient.

gaps.correct_explain: hätte (would have) is the Konjunktiv II form of haben.

wrong.hat: hat is present tense. For hypothetical descriptions, use the conditional: hätte.

gaps.correct_explain: wäre (would be) is the Konjunktiv II form of sein.

wrong.ist: ist is present tense. Use the conditional: wäre.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Ich möchte mit meinem Partner zusammenwohne.
silver.explanation: After möchte, the verb must be in the infinitive form: zusammenwohnen, not the conjugated form zusammenwohne.
silver.translation: I would like to live together with my partner.

silver.question: Build the sentence in German
silver.english: I would like to get married in ten years.

distractor_labels.heirate: wrong form — after möchte, you need the infinitive heiraten, not the conjugated form heirate

silver.source_text: On one hand, marriage is romantic. On the other hand, it costs too much.
model_answers: Einerseits ist die Ehe romantisch. Andererseits kostet es zu viel.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: I would say that marriage is important because it is a sign of love. However, many people get divorced. My ideal partner would be independent and would have good communication skills.
model_answers: Ich würde sagen, dass die Ehe wichtig ist, weil sie ein Zeichen der Liebe ist. Jedoch werden viele Menschen geschieden. Mein idealer Partner wäre unabhängig und hätte gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Check: conditional würde + infinitive at end, dass clause word order (verb at end — ist), weil + verb at end, Jedoch + inversion, wäre and hätte forms. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"2-3 sentences","improvement":"optional correction"}

gold.question: Build the sentence in German
gold.english: I would say that marriage is a waste of money.

distractor_labels.sage: wrong tense — sage is present tense. The conditional requires würde + sagen (infinitive at end of main clause).
distractor_labels.sein: wrong form — in the dass clause, the verb must be conjugated: ist (not the infinitive sein)

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a café with a friend. A member of staff comes to take your order.

bullets.prompt: Greet the member of staff and say you would like a coffee and a piece of cake.
bullets.model_answer: Guten Tag! Ich hätte gern einen Kaffee und ein Stück Kuchen, bitte.
bullets.note: Sie register; ich hätte gern + accusative noun (einen Kaffee — masculine accusative)

bullets.prompt: Ask if they have a table for two people.
bullets.model_answer: Haben Sie einen Tisch für zwei Personen?
bullets.note: formal question with Sie register; einen Tisch (masculine accusative)

bullets.prompt: Say you will come back next week because the café is very nice.
bullets.model_answer: Ich werde nächste Woche wiederkommen, weil das Café sehr schön ist.
bullets.note: werden + infinitive (future); weil + verb at end (ist)

(2) Is the German grammatically accurate? Check: Sie register, ich hätte gern + accusative, formal question structure, werden + infinitive (future), weil + verb at end. Award marks out of 10 total. Be encouraging. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"Per-bullet feedback","improvement":"Key grammar point to revise"}

gold.question: Write 40-50 words in German about marriage and future plans. Include: one argument for marriage, one argument against, what your ideal partner would be like (using hätte and wäre), and what you would like to do in the future (using möchte or würde).
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE German examiner marking extended writing about relationships and future plans. Mark on: Communication (all bullet points addressed?), Range (conditional: möchte, würde, hätte, wäre; discourse markers: einerseits, andererseits; dass clauses), Accuracy (infinitive at end after möchte/würde, verb forms, noun capitalisation). Be encouraging. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"3-4 sentences","improvement":"One grammar point"}

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Ich würde sagen, dass die Ehe wichtig ist, weil es ein Zeichen der Liebe ist. Jedoch möchte ich nicht zu früh heiraten.
gold.correct_text: Ich würde sagen, dass die Ehe wichtig ist, weil es ein Zeichen der Liebe ist. Jedoch möchte ich nicht zu früh heiraten.
gold.translation: I would say that marriage is important because it is a sign of love. However, I would not like to get married too early.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error (Higher — conditional with subordinate clause)
gold.sentence: Ich würde sagen, dass die Ehe wichtig sein.
gold.explanation: In a dass clause, the verb must be conjugated, not the infinitive. Die Ehe is singular, so use ist: dass die Ehe wichtig ist.
gold.translation: I would say that marriage is important.
